intent: Generate new project assets inspired by the user reference, not edit the reference or render UI into the image.
optimization: Lossy WebP conversion with sharp; card renditions downscaled to 960px wide. No generative edits after initial output.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production website cinematic hero background, not a UI mockup.
Primary request: a beautiful photorealistic AAA-game cinematic scene inspired by Cyberpunk 2077 Night City, for the OPEN//77 multiplayer website.
Scene/backdrop: dense futuristic metropolis at blue hour turning to night, layered towers with cyan lights and small magenta signs, atmospheric haze, rain-polished concrete rooftop.
Subject: one male mercenary seen from behind on the right third, upper body to hips visible, black leather jacket with a red stylized demon emblem, short dark undercut hair, leaning slightly on a rooftop railing looking over the city.
Composition/framing: very wide landscape 16:9. Character occupies right 35%, distant skyline through the middle, left 48% kept mostly dark and softly detailed for a large white headline overlaid later in HTML. Character's head below top 18% to leave clear navigation space. Skyline has luminous detail without clutter.
Lighting/mood: cinematic teal-blue rim light, restrained red highlights, compelling depth, moody and polished, realistic fabric and concrete, no bloom overload.
Constraints: image artwork only, no website, no UI, no text, no readable letters, no logos or watermarks, no extra foreground people. Crisp high-resolution image.
assets.usage: Alternate hero; superseded by the user's chosen wallpaper, retained for reuse.
